text.card: A red giant 3,779 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.73 solar masses and 10.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,925 K at its surface.
